integrity: Finite checks are corroboration only; formulas and all-dimensional classification rest on the stated algebraic proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts only right multiplication by the near-socle ideal for n >= 5; other ideals and other operator invariants are excluded. Historical priority of an implicit corollary is unverified. The n=5 characteristic-two specialization is covered by a published full-algebra rank census and is not claimed original.
title: Complete near-socle right-multiplication Jordan spectra in finite exterior algebras
